test_title: PYST 12: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

 # : IFL :: KHN : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : IFL :: KHN : %

Analysis of Options:

**Option 1) # = CJS, % = KJI**

**For # (CJS) to IFL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/321f7b7bc27c12d699fea55f86ac21022fa207594332ddebf26b42e6b005fb2a.png] 

 

**For KHN to % (KJI)**

 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d7de7b6fcb0acbc1e10943a2a0a3a803726b204ac9cae865e42659c4fbe8057.png] 

Since the pattern for CJS to IFL (+6, -4, -7) is not the same as the pattern for KHN to KJI (0, +2, -5),

Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = LPG, % = NUY**

**For # (LPG) to IFL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/869c7e477345dc47215da2d9498927a21dcc3bb261f0a96efd9974f6852d6f86.png] 

 

**For KHN to % (NUY)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1635f530a092cce1634651b28be01e499c19f66297b16d42e2de6b0c2254bac7.png] 

 

Since the pattern for LPG to IFL (-3, -10, +5) is not the same as the pattern for KHN to NUY (+3, +13, +11),

Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = DAG, % = PMS**

**For # (DAG) to IFL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44c527cb2e66099a6e0b8c6660eab1f78df06e877c37626148f28714f61dd5f8.png] 

 

**For KHN to % (PMS)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91a21ae5e16d93bd082774b609cad39140a09d50fd4c984b53577e79fb8b7e65.png] 

Since the pattern for DAG to IFL (+5, +5, +5) is the same as the pattern for KHN to PMS (+5, +5, +5), Option 3 is correct.

**Option 4) # = KHY, % = NHU**

**For # (KHY) to IFL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89d06009fa20de3a122e3610aafc729101aad99fecf01ce8031f7a86acafdc96.png] 

 

**For KHN to % (NHU)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0404b8a77db1e5be198511b70f6020e68acb6cb35dd9623127dc0e0321d4df7d.png] 

Since the pattern for KHY to IFL (-2, -2, -13) is not the same as the pattern for KHN to NHU (+3, +13, +7), Option 4 is incorrect.

Thus, the analogy holds true only for **Option 3** where the pattern (+5, +5, +5) is consistent for both pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
